checkedAlternates.risk: Rime contains the nucleus and coda.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Onset and Rime are the two top-level branches of a syllable (group-2), whereas Nucleus and Coda sit inside the Rime (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Mora relates to syllable timing and length.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A mora is a sub-syllabic weight unit (group-1), distinct from prosodic features like stress, tone, and intonation (group-4).
